evidence.positive: Inserted a stale Quartz job (post-insulin-glucose-check.stale-demo-A, JobDataMap TENANT_ID=demo-demo copied from the demo-demo cleaner's own blob, SIMPLE trigger start_time 40h in the past, next_fire_time 30 days out) into the shared public.qrtz_* tables plus an open job_metadata row (completed=false) in the demo-demo schema, then made the demo-demo cleaner due by setting hourly-run-demo-demo next_fire_time to now. Within 3s the app logged, with MDC tenant demo-demo: 'Executing job cleaner...' / 'Deleting stale job: post-insulin-glucose-check.stale-demo-A' / 'Job cleaner complete'. Afterwards qrtz_job_details had no stale-demo-A row and "demo-demo".job_metadata showed stale-demo-A|completed=t. Repeated after the class restore with stale-demo-C: same log lines under demo-demo at 21:14:53Z, job gone, metadata completed=t.
evidence.negative: With the same stale demo-demo job (stale-demo-A) and open metadata row in place, made the mgb-mgh cleaner due first (hourly-run-mgb-mgh next_fire_time=now). Log at 21:07:47Z under MDC tenant mgb-mgh showed only 'Executing job cleaner...' and 'Job cleaner complete' with no 'Deleting stale job' line; qrtz_job_details still held stale-demo-A, "demo-demo".job_metadata still showed stale-demo-A|f, and hourly-run-mgb-mgh prev_fire_time advanced to 21:07:40Z proving the run happened. Repeated after the class restore with stale-demo-C at 21:14:03Z: same result, job and open metadata untouched by the mgb-mgh cleaner.
evidence.red_check: Compiled the parent commit's JobCleanerJob and QuartzJobService (clean() with no tenant, getStaleJobKeys without the isOwnedBy filter; @Slf4j replaced by an explicit LoggerFactory logger) with the container's javac against /app/classes:/app/libs/*, backed up the three shipped .class files to /tmp/backup with md5sums (JobCleanerJob ea6e114e..., QuartzJobService 3dbac2dd..., $SchedulerType df1904bc...), copied the pre-fix classes into /app/classes and restarted the container (ready in ~15s, cleaners re-registered). Inserted stale-demo-R owned by demo-demo with an open demo-demo metadata row and made the mgb-mgh cleaner due. Log at 21:11:44Z under MDC tenant mgb-mgh: 'Deleting stale job: post-insulin-glucose-check.stale-demo-R'. qrtz_job_details lost the row while "demo-demo".job_metadata still showed stale-demo-R|f, i.e. the other tenant deleted the job and the owner's metadata was left open, the exact defect in the commit message. Reverted by copying the backups back, md5sums matched the shipped values for all three classes, restarted, readiness UP, then re-ran the negative (stale-demo-C untouched by mgb-mgh) and positive (stale-demo-C deleted by demo-demo, metadata completed=t). That signature line appears exactly once in the full container log, during the swap.

caveats: Stale jobs were inserted directly into the Quartz tables (JobDataMap blob copied from the demo-demo cleaner, so it carries only TENANT_ID) rather than scheduled by a rule; real jobs carry TENANT_ID via JobMetadata.generateJobDataMap, which is the same key the ownership filter reads.
Cleaners were fired by setting the cron trigger's next_fire_time to now instead of waiting for the top-of-hour cron; the job executed through the normal Quartz path with tenant MDC set.
Only the LowFrequency scheduler was exercised; the HighFrequency path is the same loop over a second scheduler instance and was not separately populated.
The Sentry event's actual exception is not in the ticket (only the job key), so the specific error seen on dev was not reproduced; the cross-tenant deletion the fix targets was.
Concurrent cleaners (all four fire at :00 on real deployments) were not run simultaneously.
The orphaned stale-demo-R metadata row from the red check was left open in the disposable instance's demo-demo schema.

automation.assessment: The merged JobCleanerJobIntegrationTest already covers own-tenant delete + metadata completion, other-tenant untouched, mixed tenants, under-threshold job kept, and the cleaner never deleting itself. It is a *IntegrationTest, which the default surefire config excludes and only the integration-tests profile runs, so this coverage does not execute on every CI run. Worth locking in a fast unit test of the ownership filter that runs in the default suite; nothing further at the e2e level.
proposed_tests: QuartzJobServiceTest (unit, default suite): getStaleJobKeys with a mocked Scheduler returns only stale JobKeys whose JobDetail JobDataMap TENANT_ID equals the requested tenant, and drops a stale key whose getJobDetail throws SchedulerException.

jira_comment:
Verdict: deploy-ready.

Positive: A 40-hour-old Quartz job owned by demo-demo with an open metadata row was deleted by the demo-demo cleaner and its metadata was marked complete.
Negative: The mgb-mgh cleaner ran against the same stale demo-demo job and left both the job and its open metadata untouched.
Red check: With the pre-fix classes swapped into the running container, the mgb-mgh cleaner deleted the demo-demo job and left its metadata open; the shipped classes were restored and verified by checksum.

Automation: The merged integration test covers the scenarios but only runs under the integration-tests profile, so a default-suite unit test of the ownership filter is proposed.
